In all divisions the top eight teams qualified for the knockout playoff system. Contrary to [[NQR Season 6]], [[E2M2TDM]] was ditched and replaced by [[CMT4]]. Notably, '''Nations Quake Rank 7''' also saw [[Clan MalFunction]] become Champions after [[Slackers]] had won the previous 3 seasons. In Division 2, [[Eläintarha]] walked through the Division 2 playoffs like it was nothing. Old [[CTF]] clan [[Veni Vidi Vici]] showed the other Division 3 teams how to play cmt4 while in a Swedish Division 4 final [[Postal Justice]] ensured victory. Last but not least the animals in [[Bufflarna flyger i luften]] were flying high and claimed the Division 5 title.
